status_note: Version 0.5 adds individual practice for nine existing trials, contextual learning, a separate per-archetype notebook and in-game manual/focus pause. Competitive contracts and 27 Mix mappings are unchanged. Exact evidence is in docs/qa/V0_5_VERIFICATION.md. The remaining 16 trials, full realms, online play and compiled playable UE5 assets remain planned.

prototype.title: THE EYES — The Trial Workshop

ritual.counterplay: Keep moving inside the ring around the central pedestal; if retreat is necessary, only the final hold resets and lit vessels remain.

clock.start_reachability_note: The paired-hand graph reaches 108 states from a target; bounded breadth-first selection chooses among its 48 states at shortest distance four. Every generated start therefore requires exactly four optimal legal turns, followed by explicit confirmation. Arbitrary unrelated states are not assumed reachable.

persistence.practice_backup_recovery: only when primary is absent; corrupt and future primary files are preserved

contracts.label: Seeded Mix
contracts.selection: one seeded ternary choice per bay
contracts.migration_note: v0.4 changes old Mix seed mapping; same-version selection remains deterministic

prototype.inactive_apparatus_policy: Replace or fully disable geometry, pickups, prompts and progress actions for the inactive trial in each bay.

native_presentation.renderer: native OpenGL compatibility; software Mesa; Xvfb

unopposed_bot_routes.contracts: Second plus all eight Seeded Mix combinations

squad_life_domain.scope_note: Domain-only suite; physical evidence is recorded separately.

interface_api.scope: five-argument start signal, roster states, map exclusion, spectator/result copy, menu reset and Eye map
interface_api.rendered_scope: menu, five-member roster, staged rescue, staged spectator and scrollable manual; actual native software renderer, not hardware performance or full-match evidence

practice.selection: one trial, one archetype, one seed
practice.guide: authored controls and public progress; no unseen puzzle answers
practice.guide_toggle_scope: active Workshop gameplay only; hidden during map, Echoes, pause and manual without changing the chosen state

interaction_settings.fov_scope: survivor and spectator; Eye remains 85 degrees

invariants: Eye position only changes between authored sockets
Damage needs readable warning and valid counterplay
Every active mandatory objective remains reachable
First valid survivor escape wins the base round
No role is required to solve a mandatory trial
Gameplay information has accessible redundant cues

realms.title: Dollhouse
realms.exit: Grand stair and raised handle platform

trials.title: The Labyrinth of Shadows
trials.goal: Activate three index switches in an authored shifting maze.
trials.eye_intervention: Future wall shift with connectivity validation
trials.counterplay: A safe service spine and recovery pockets

trials.title: The Silent Countdown
trials.goal: Deliver three unique whisper motes while managing in-game noise.
trials.eye_intervention: Threaten a visible lane or investigate a noise cue
trials.counterplay: Walk or crouch, take cover, recover dropped motes

trials.title: Threads of Fate
trials.goal: Cross a platform course using bounded paired tethers and shared strain.
trials.eye_intervention: Accelerate one announced obstacle
trials.counterplay: Reduce tension, pin an endpoint, use recovery trays

trials.title: Light in the Darkness
trials.goal: Connect three refuge lamps using limited portable light.
trials.eye_intervention: Dim one nonessential light or summon a phantom
trials.counterplay: Share illumination and recharge at refuges

trials.title: Trial of the Echoes
trials.goal: Repeat a demonstrated seeded four-symbol permutation.
trials.eye_intervention: Introduce distinguishable decoys or threaten the station
trials.counterplay: Replay or read the true cue frame; retry the current attempt

trials.title: Bridge of Illusions
trials.goal: Certify a safe route through three banks of unstable tiles.
trials.eye_intervention: Move an unoccupied future tile with warning
trials.counterplay: Probe support clues and retreat before collapse

trials.title: Strings of Despair
trials.goal: Decode support relations and release suspended frames.
trials.eye_intervention: Obscure one duplicate clue or interrupt a cut
trials.counterplay: Compare shape-tagged ropes and use the viewing balcony

trials.title: Clockwork Relay
trials.goal: Hold a mechanism through three charge stages while managing exposure.
trials.checkpoint: Prototype: four and eight seconds of twelve
trials.eye_intervention: Threaten an operator or rewind only unbanked work
trials.counterplay: Retreat at banks and coordinate stabilization

trials.title: Glass Symphony
trials.goal: Cross resonant waves using explicitly marked acoustic shields.
trials.eye_intervention: Select an emitter or arm brittle glass
trials.counterplay: Read wave fronts and shelter behind solid shields

trials.title: The Ritual Circle
trials.goal: Light five vessels by a clue-supported sequence and hold the ring.
trials.eye_intervention: Extinguish one unbanked vessel or call a phantom
trials.counterplay: Bank pairs and share ember carrying

trials.title: The Tower of Babel
trials.goal: Assemble a supported access tower from snapped structural pieces.
trials.eye_intervention: Shake an unbraced section or threaten a supply lane
trials.counterplay: Over-brace, inspect loads, use locked platforms

trials.title: Mirrors of Deceit
trials.goal: Identify true passages through consistent reflected and engraved clues.
trials.eye_intervention: Animate a false reflection or shatter a nonessential mirror
trials.counterplay: Compare two clues and inspect suspicious silhouettes

trials.title: The Abyss Walk
trials.goal: Cross a wind-swept causeway and secure three stabilizers.
trials.eye_intervention: Select an announced gust direction
trials.counterplay: Brace, shelter, and use lower recovery shelves

trials.title: Warden’s Chains
trials.goal: Move a shared anchor carriage through three chain-lock puzzles.
trials.eye_intervention: Energize one chain or reduce announced slack
trials.counterplay: Pin endpoints and operate emergency releases

trials.title: The Marionette’s Dance
trials.goal: Perform three action phrases while rejecting visibly false instructions.
trials.eye_intervention: Add a framed decoy or alter the next announced tempo
trials.counterplay: Follow true cue frames and release accumulated tension

trials.title: The Clock Room
trials.goal: Align linked clock hands through visible discrete gear relationships.
trials.eye_intervention: Engage a known announced offset or threaten a sector
trials.counterplay: Use reversible controls, clutches, and the ratio diagram

trials.title: Chimes of Doom
trials.goal: Ring two bell phrases while managing sound-sensitive pursuit.
trials.eye_intervention: Move an unclaimed bell between phrases or add a phantom
trials.counterplay: Dampen bells and use sound distractions

trials.title: The Spiral Stairs
trials.goal: Ascend three controlled stair segments with safe orientation transitions.
trials.eye_intervention: Cycle a future segment within a safe schedule
trials.counterplay: Lock segments and use recovery landings

trials.title: Strings of Time
trials.goal: Carry a charged vessel through threads that add explicit time debt.
trials.eye_intervention: Extend an unoccupied thread after warning
trials.counterplay: Cut anchors or take a longer clear route

trials.title: The Gauntlet
trials.goal: Clear beam, pressure-tile, and sweeping-arm rooms in sequence.
trials.eye_intervention: Accelerate one legal hazard schedule
trials.counterplay: Use vestibules, latches, and the safe service lane

trials.title: The Infernal Carousel
trials.goal: Disable three brakes on a rotating ring and align the exit.
trials.eye_intervention: Choose bounded speed or one announced obstacle
trials.counterplay: Use the center refuge and radial lanes

trials.title: Masks of Fear
trials.goal: Match three mask protections to explicit phantom behaviors.
trials.eye_intervention: Corrupt one mask for an announced bounded interval
trials.counterplay: Switch masks, wait in refuge, or lure threats

trials.title: The Bone Bridge
trials.goal: Build and brace a load-limited bridge above a rising heat basin.
trials.eye_intervention: Accelerate heat or damage an unbanked brace
trials.counterplay: Distribute weight and inspect cursed pieces

trials.title: The Memory Vault
trials.goal: Retrieve four identified objects and place them in ordered cradles.
trials.eye_intervention: Move unclaimed decoys or obscure a duplicate aisle label
trials.counterplay: Inspect objects, replay reference, and divide memory roles

trials.title: Whispers of the Void
trials.goal: Choose three routes using evidence that identifies truthful testimony.
trials.eye_intervention: Amplify a false voice or add a decoy statement
trials.counterplay: Compare physical markers and complete captions
